title: Folded note
description: A private note folds into a sealed paper billet, retaining its contents when opened again.
useCase: Give a short local draft a tactile completion state while keeping validation and editing reversible.
interaction: Enter a recipient email and note, seal the draft, then open it again; cancel while folding
reducedMotion: Valid submission moves directly to the sealed state without 3D folding or rotation. Reopening retains the same fields and restores text focus.
limitations: Local draft only; no message is sent or stored persistently. Host pause and document hiding suspend the finite fold sequence. A production send action requires a real submission handler and successful response before claiming delivery.
look: Dark charcoal page with a vermilion letter form in three creased panels: italic serif label, large serif note, monospace caption and maroon button.
motion: Submitting folds the top panel down, then the bottom panel up (360 ms each, cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)), then the billet tucks to a tilted 0.9 scale; cancel or open restores the form.
adapt: A `phase` state machine (`top`, `bottom`, `tuck`, `sealed`) advances on timers from `LENGTH`; `data-phase` CSS runs `sf-note-top` and `sf-note-bottom` on the `.fold-model` flaps, then `sf-note-tuck` on `.paper`. Wire `onSubmit` to your real send; `remaining` keeps timers pause-safe.
